title: Iron physiology, iron overload, and the porphyrias

units.name: Introduction
units.assessment: Can you account for the 1 to 2 mg of iron absorbed each day against total body iron stores and daily erythropoietic demand, and explain why humans have no regulated route of iron excretion?

lesson.title: Iron Pathway In Human Body. Regulation of Iron absorption. Role of Ferritin and Transferrin
lesson.why: A compact orientation to the whole iron circuit — absorption, transferrin transport, ferritin storage, macrophage recycling — which is all this one-page introduction needs to set up.

units.name: Regulation of iron homeostasis
units.assessment: Can you explain how hepcidin binding to ferroportin changes iron egress from enterocytes and macrophages, and name the stimuli — iron stores, inflammation, erythroferrone, hypoxia — that raise or suppress hepcidin?

lesson.title: Iron homeostasis and its disorders: from iron-deficiency anemia to hereditary hemochromatosis
lesson.why: A university department-of-medicine lecture that builds the hepcidin–ferroportin axis from first principles and then uses it to explain both iron deficiency and hemochromatosis.

drills.name: Full lecture on iron regulation
drills.title: REGULATION OF IRON HOMEOSTASIS
drills.channel: Hematology and blood transfusion science lecture

units.name: Intestinal iron absorption
units.assessment: Can you trace a dietary ferric iron atom from the duodenal lumen into plasma transferrin, naming the brush-border reductase, the apical and basolateral transporters, and the ferroxidase involved?

lesson.title: Iron | Dr. Tony Talebi lectures on Iron metabolism in Hematology
lesson.why: A hematologist's tour of iron handling aimed at trainees, covering absorption, transport and storage in the sequence this section uses.

drills.name: Deep physiology of iron and heme
drills.title: Iron and heme metabolism

units.name: Hereditary hemochromatosis and other iron overload disorders
units.assessment: Which HFE genotype accounts for most clinical iron overload, why is its clinical penetrance so low, and how do non-HFE hereditary forms and transfusional iron overload differ mechanistically?

lesson.title: Medical Grand Rounds - The Hereditary Hemochromatosis Clinic at Mayo Clinic
lesson.why: A Mayo grand rounds from a dedicated hemochromatosis clinic: genotype–phenotype discordance, penetrance, family screening and who actually needs treatment.

drills.name: Short clinical primer on HH
drills.title: Mayo Clinic: William Palmer, M.D. - Hereditary Hemochromatosis

drills.name: Full CME lecture on hemochromatosis
drills.title: “Hemochromatosis: Too Much of a Good Thing,” Robert T. Means M.D.

units.name: Clinical presentation and diagnosis
units.assessment: Which test comes first when iron overload is suspected, what transferrin saturation threshold should prompt HFE genotyping, and when do liver MRI or biopsy still add information about fibrosis?

lesson.title: Iron Overload Part II ADULT HEMOCHROMATOSIS
lesson.why: A long hepatology lecture devoted to adult hemochromatosis that spends most of its time on presentation, iron studies, imaging and the diagnostic algorithm.

drills.name: Lab-medicine view of the iron panel
drills.title: Chapter 20- Disorders of Iron and Heme Metabolism

units.name: Treatment
units.assessment: Can you state the phlebotomy schedule and ferritin target used to de-iron hemochromatosis, say which complications reverse and which do not, and name the settings where chelation replaces phlebotomy?

lesson.title: Chapter 4 Iron Overload
lesson.why: A university lecture on iron overload management that covers both arms of treatment — therapeutic phlebotomy for the non-anemic patient and chelation for transfusional overload.

drills.name: Treatment discussion in the hemochromatosis lecture
drills.title: Iron Overload Part II ADULT HEMOCHROMATOSIS

units.name: The porphyrias
units.assessment: Can you place each porphyria at its blocked enzyme in the heme biosynthesis pathway and predict from that position whether the patient presents with neurovisceral attacks, blistering skin lesions, or non-blistering painful photosensitivity?

lesson.title: APFCB Masterclass: Porphyrias
lesson.why: A professional-society masterclass that lays out the whole pathway, the enzyme block behind each porphyria, and the laboratory pattern each one produces.

units.name: Clinical features of acute porphyria
units.assessment: Which first-line urine tests establish an acute hepatic porphyria attack, and can you name the drugs, hormonal states and caloric conditions that precipitate attacks by inducing ALA synthase 1?

lesson.title: The Acute Porphyrias: Diagnosis, Management and Beyond
lesson.why: A porphyria-centre lecture on the acute hepatic porphyrias: attack presentation, spot urine PBG testing, hemin and the newer RNAi therapy, plus long-term complications.

units.name: Blistering cutaneous porphyrias
units.assessment: How would you separate porphyria cutanea tarda from variegate porphyria and hereditary coproporphyria using plasma fluorescence emission, urine porphyrin fractionation and stool porphyrins?

lesson.title: Porphyrias
lesson.why: A chemical-pathology lecture that works through the blistering porphyrias and, crucially, the biochemical patterns that tell PCT apart from VP and HCP.

drills.name: Dermatology view of photosensitivity
drills.title: Lecture-114: Cutaneous Photosensitivity diseases, Part-I. Rook's chapter 127.

units.name: Treatment of PCT
units.assessment: Can you name the two accepted treatments for porphyria cutanea tarda, the biochemical endpoint each is titrated to, and the susceptibility factors — hepatitis C, alcohol, estrogen, HFE variants — that should be removed first?

lesson.note: Re-searched on the treatments themselves - phlebotomy, low-dose hydroxychloroquine, ferritin endpoints - rather than on the ambiguous abbreviation PCT. The pool is still only board-preparation dermatology, a self-described beginner's guide, a student presentation, a Wikipedia audio reading and an Urdu-language hydroxychloroquine pharmacy clip, plus a library lecture on the history of bloodletting. The previous pick has been withdrawn because it is exam-prep content; nothing at specialist level on titrating phlebotomy or low-dose hydroxychloroquine in porphyria cutanea tarda exists in the pool.

units.name: Congenital erythropoietic porphyria
units.assessment: Which enzyme deficiency causes congenital erythropoietic porphyria, and can you explain how it produces mutilating photosensitivity, hemolytic anemia, splenomegaly and erythrodontia in the same patient?

lesson.title: Porphyrias | Dr. Tony Talebi lectures on Porphyrias
lesson.why: A hematology-directed lecture on the porphyrias that places the erythropoietic forms, including Gunther disease, against the hepatic ones.

units.name: Erythropoietic protoporphyria
units.assessment: Can you explain why erythropoietic protoporphyria causes burning photosensitivity without blistering, which single test makes the diagnosis, and which patients are at risk of protoporphyric liver failure?

lesson.title: Porphyria pathology
lesson.why: A pathology lecture that covers the protoporphyrias alongside the rest of the group, including why free protoporphyrin accumulation gives pain rather than blisters.

drills.name: Genetics behind EPP
drills.title: The etiology of erythropoietic protoporphyria
